path.description: The image or video file to redact.

x.description: Left edge of the region, in pixels.

y.description: Top edge of the region, in pixels.

startTime.description: Video only, seconds. Omit for images or to redact from the start.

endTime.description: Video only, seconds. Omit for images or to redact to the end.

outputPath.description: Where to write the redacted file. Must not already exist.
